# technitium Provider

Manages a Technitium DNS Server through its HTTP API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "technitium" {
  host  = "http://dns.example.com:5380"
  token = var.technitium_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) API address, e.g. http://localhost:5380. Defaults to TECHNITIUM_HOST.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. Defaults to TECHNITIUM_INSECURE, or false.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for username. Defaults to TECHNITIUM_PASSWORD.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token. Defaults to TECHNITIUM_TOKEN. Conflicts with username and password.
- `username` (String) User to log in as when no token is set. Defaults to TECHNITIUM_USERNAME.
